name: pairbrowse
description: Pair-browse with Codex: it fills sign-ups, listings and settings pages in a visible PairBrowse browser window at full speed, keeps your logins, and hands you only the CAPTCHAs, 2FA and final submits.

interface.shortDescription: Fill web forms in a browser you watch and step into
interface.longDescription: PairBrowse runs its own visible browser. Codex fills sign-ups, registrations, app listings and store settings at full speed; you solve CAPTCHAs, sign in with 2FA and confirm every pay, publish, delete or submit. Passwords stay in PairBrowse and are typed only on the sites you allow.
defaultPrompt: Sign me up on this site in PairBrowse
